name: Keyboard Studio
overview: Keyboard Studio is a keyboard you design yourself. Pick a ready-made picture keyboard, build one from parts, or import a picture of your own, then tune the layout, keys, letters, colors and shortcut keys. It types in every app, works offline, and never sends what you type anywhere.

capabilities.title: Three ways to start
capabilities.text: Simple (pick a look and go), Guided (one step at a time) or Advanced (everything at once), plus Quick picks of your own keyboards on the first screen.

proofs.caption: First screen: Simple, Guided, Advanced and Quick picks

capabilities.title: Picture keyboards
capabilities.text: Ready-made Mecha keyboards (Fire, Gold, Ice, Mint, Stealth, Toxic, Violet) and Pro sets. One tap switches the whole keyboard.

proofs.caption: Tap Mecha Gold: the keyboard changes
Tap Mecha Ice: the keyboard changes again

capabilities.title: Live preview and test key
capabilities.text: The keyboard you are building sits at the top and changes with every tap; the TEST KEY beside it shows one key up close.

proofs.caption: Live preview with the TEST KEY beside it

capabilities.title: Finger Coach
capabilities.text: Short lines point at the real control and say what to do next, step by step.

proofs.caption: Coach line: "Tap a keyboard. Every tap changes the keyboard up here."

capabilities.title: Types in every app
capabilities.text: Pick it as your keyboard and it types in any app on the phone.

proofs.caption: Typing "demo" in a contacts form, key by key

capabilities.title: Word suggestions
capabilities.text: Word suggestions above the keys as you type.

capabilities.title: G keys
capabilities.text: A column of programmable shortcut keys: copy, paste, cut, select all, undo, or your own text, app or address.

proofs.caption: ALL key pressed: the whole word is selected

capabilities.title: Numbers and symbols
capabilities.text: The 123 key opens math, punctuation and symbols; ABC goes back.

capabilities.title: Advanced editor
capabilities.text: Everything at once: Undo/Redo, Save/Load, Report, tabs for layout, keys, letters and fonts, colors and extras, and a choice of preview on top, real keyboard, or side by side.

proofs.caption: Advanced editor, open Fold, side by side 60/40

capabilities.title: Your own keyboard from a picture
capabilities.text: Import a picture of a keyboard and the app finds the keys, cleans the letters off and builds your own keyboard.

capabilities.title: KitBasher
capabilities.text: Build a keyboard from parts: mix keys from any set, roll the dice, harmonize colors, share a build code.

capabilities.title: Layouts
capabilities.text: Core, Split, 65, 76, 96 and 108-key layouts; the phone, the open Fold and a tablet each remember their own.

capabilities.title: Shapes, colors and borders
capabilities.text: 16 drawn key shapes, borders, wallpaper, per-key colors and see-through keys.

capabilities.title: Letters and fonts
capabilities.text: 16 fonts plus your own, size, width, height and color of the letters, ALL CAPS or all small.

capabilities.title: Number pad
capabilities.text: Key order, side, the green GO/OK/NEXT key, spacing and shuffled digits.

capabilities.title: Swipe typing
capabilities.text: Swipe across the letters to type, with a trail you can color.

capabilities.title: Voice typing
capabilities.text: Tap the microphone key and speak.

capabilities.title: Screenshot key
capabilities.text: A key that takes a screenshot and saves it where you choose.

capabilities.title: App Adapt
capabilities.text: A different look and font for each app.

capabilities.title: Offline and private
capabilities.text: No internet permission: nothing you type leaves the phone. The only permission at install is vibration.

demo.caption: 26 seconds on the test bench: typing "hello demo" key by key with suggestions, the 123 symbols, the ALL key, then switching looks in the app.

note: Captured on the Fold (open) bench profile, Android 15 emulator, with demo text only.
